quest.title: Tadhla the Falcon
quest.description: Tadhla, Masseira's "Falcon," has been on a mission for a long time and has not returned. Thus Masseira asks you to find his "Falcon"...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x200, Primogem x30, Mora x20000, Hero's Wit x2

dialogues.speaker: Masseira
dialogues.text: #Ah, {NICKNAME}, esteemed Master of the Jinni. To what do I owe the pleasure?

dialogues.speaker: Liloupar
dialogues.text: Splendid. Another desert-spawn. My master, I— *sigh* Never mind. I trust your judgment.

dialogues.speaker: Masseira
dialogues.text: Could you spare a minute for me? I've been looking forward to seeing you as I've been to seeing the moon and rain.

dialogues.speaker: Liloupar
dialogues.text: Don't let us doubt your intent. Just cut to the chase.

dialogues.speaker: Masseira
dialogues.text: Very well, Master of the Jinni, I do have a request...

dialogues.speaker: Masseira
dialogues.text: Haha, nothing serious. It's just my Falcon, Tadhla. I think she's in danger.

dialogues.speaker: Masseira
dialogues.text: *sigh* If it weren't for my weak legs, I wouldn't be troubling you for this...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Correct Paimon if she's wrong. You want us to rescue her before thanking us profusely, paying us a large sum of Mora, and treating us to a big meal for our triumph, right?

dialogues.speaker: Masseira
dialogues.text: Uh... Yes, yes.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, if that's the case, we'll do it!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Paimon always gets extra logical when it comes to such situations...

dialogues.speaker: Liloupar
dialogues.text: *sigh* Alright, let's do it for Paimon's big meal.

dialogues.speaker: Masseira
dialogues.text: Thank you so much. I'm counting on you.

dialogues.speaker: Masseira
dialogues.text: Let me mark out her last known location.

dialogues.speaker: Masseira
dialogues.text: The person you need to look for, Tadhla, is tall, tanned, with light-colored long hair, and uses a long bow. Yes, this should be enough information about her.

dialogues.speaker: Masseira
dialogues.text: Did you get it all?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm... A tall, tanned girl with light-colored long hair and holds a long bow! Hehe, Paimon has an excellent memory!

dialogues.speaker: Masseira
dialogues.text: May the wind guide you through sandstorms and away from danger.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Thank you. We'll see you soon!

talks.objective: Go to Tadhla's last known location

dialogues.speaker: Masseira
dialogues.text: Did you find her?

dialogues.speaker: Masseira
dialogues.text: I see, you still need some time.

dialogues.speaker: Masseira
dialogues.text: Please find her as soon as possible. Time is not on our side.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Shh... See? There's someone over there!

dialogues.speaker: Liloupar
dialogues.text: Hmm... My master, be those the people whom you mentioned? The "Fooltui"?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It's the "Fatui."

dialogues.speaker: Liloupar
dialogues.text: That name makes them sound no wiser.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Shh! Keep it down! If they see us...

dialogues.speaker: Liloupar
dialogues.text: Be placid. They hear nothing of my words. Here, bear witness...

dialogues.speaker: Liloupar
dialogues.text: Ahoy! You! Corpulent one! Over here! Time to eat!

dialogues.speaker: Fatui Skirmisher No. 1
dialogues.text: Hmm? Did you hear anything?

dialogues.speaker: Fatui Skirmisher No. 2
dialogues.text: No, why?

dialogues.speaker: Fatui Skirmisher No. 1
dialogues.text: Hmm... I thought I heard someone saying time to eat.

dialogues.speaker: Liloupar
dialogues.text: Hehe, see?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon didn't know Liloupar has a childlike side! Hehe, it's adorable.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Look! Over there! Is that Tadhla they got locked up?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm... Tall, tanned, light-colored long hair... That should be her.

dialogues.speaker: Liloupar
dialogues.text: Well done, little one. The task is upon us, my master.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Yeah, {NICKNAME}, let's do this!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Um... Are you Tadhla? We are here to get you out!

dialogues.speaker: Tadhla
dialogues.text: Yes...? Oh, yes.

dialogues.speaker: Tadhla
dialogues.text: You let them go.

choices.text: They are no longer a threat.

response.speaker: Tadhla
response.text: ...They will flee and send warning to their comrades. Soon, they will all know that we are here.

response.speaker: Liloupar
response.text: The wise are joined of thought. I like this girl.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: It doesn't matter. If they come back for us, we'll just kick their butts again! Although... you're injured. Do you need help?

response.speaker: Tadhla
response.text: I'm okay. I can still walk and find myself a decent place to die in peace.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, that's a relief, she can still walk and find herself a decent place to— Hey! That's not what Paimon expected to hear!

response.speaker: Tadhla
response.text: Just kidding.

response.speaker: Liloupar
response.text: Hahaha.

response.speaker: Liloupar
response.text: I like this girl's humor... Her vagaries are most amusing.

response.speaker: Tadhla
response.text: Thank you. Let's return to the tribe.

response.speaker: Tadhla
response.text: It is, but I don't need any help.

choices.text: You don't even need any rest?

response.speaker: Tadhla
response.text: Rest? No. I barely know you.

response.speaker: Liloupar
response.text: Then, perhaps we should get more acquainted. What say you?

response.speaker: Tadhla
response.text: Thank you, but maybe later.

choices.text: We don't need to kill them.

dialogues.speaker: Masseira
dialogues.text: Ah, here's my little Falcon! Thank you so much!

dialogues.speaker: Tadhla
dialogues.text: Sorry, I was ambushed. It was all thanks to them that I can return and see you again.

dialogues.speaker: Masseira
dialogues.text: "Them"? Your "them" is our esteemed Master of the Jinni!

dialogues.speaker: Tadhla
dialogues.text: I'm sorry...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh come on, it's okay! Tadhla is injured, be nice to her!

dialogues.speaker: Masseira
dialogues.text: You're injured?

dialogues.speaker: Tadhla
dialogues.text: I'm sorry.

dialogues.speaker: Masseira
dialogues.text: By what? Animal, or human?

dialogues.speaker: Tadhla
dialogues.text: It was the northerners. They ambushed me after realizing they were being followed.

dialogues.speaker: Masseira
dialogues.text: You should've been the ambusher.

dialogues.speaker: Masseira
dialogues.text: Being attacked by the prey. What a shame for a Falcon.

dialogues.speaker: Masseira
dialogues.text: Go rest. I'll tend to your wound later.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Tadhla silently nods and slowly treads away in pain.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Masseira sure is a bit too strict with Tadhla...

choices.text: Are you two not getting along?

response.speaker: Masseira
response.text: Hmm? No, that would be nonsense. She's my favorite Falcon. I love her, but I don't spoil her. How do you feed a Falcon if the Falcon comes back empty-handed?

response.speaker: Liloupar
response.text: Ah, so such is the case... An ugly end awaits this girl.

response.speaker: Masseira
response.text: Please accept this. You have my gratitude, esteemed Master of the Jinni.

response.speaker: Liloupar
response.text: Ahem. Aren't you forgetting something? There are still two of us besides your Master of the Jinni.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hehe, Paimon doubts both of us are qualified to accept the reward...

response.speaker: Liloupar
response.text: Ah... Yes, of course. The fact that this floating fairy is technically not a person has eluded me till thus, but perhaps the rest of us people may receive due thanks?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey!

response.speaker: Masseira
response.text: Haha, my apologies. Please take this as an extra payment.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ooh, extra payment!

response.speaker: Liloupar
response.text: ...Still more paltry than my expectations... But I suppose I will accept this if you should not object, my master.

response.speaker: Masseira
response.text: Very well. If you are available in the future, please come back one more time. I think my Falcon will need your help by then.

choices.text: Please don't be too harsh to her.

response.speaker: Masseira
response.text: Harsh? No, instead I've been too kind to her. That's why she has become so... sloppy. All I'm doing is educating her. She's an outstanding Falcon. How could I ever hurt her?

response.speaker: Liloupar
response.text: So, then, what stands as the most common fate to grace a Falcon...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Tadhla isn't here. Should we keep looking?

dialogues.speaker: Liloupar
dialogues.text: Cast your gaze here... There are a great many footprints. It appears the fellows that once dwelt within the delves of this cave were an active and... careless lot.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That makes sense. Let's go in and investigate!

dialogues.speaker: Fatui Skirmisher No. 1
dialogues.text: This position is lost! Fall back! Fall back!

dialogues.speaker: Liloupar
dialogues.text: They ran away... Why must you bestow so much mercy on the undeserving, my master?
